body.name: quasi-uniform signed-cross-tail experiment class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M=\{(P_N,\mathcal S_N)_{N\ge1}: d\in\{1,2\},\ D\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{BL}}(d,D_0),\ c_mN^{-1/d}\le h_N\le C_mN^{-1/d},\ \delta_N\ge c_sh_N,\ \beta\in\operatorname{int}(\mathcal B),\ 1/2<p_{\min}\le p\le p_{\max}<1,\ A\in[-A_{\max},A_{\max}],\ (c_X,c_W,\alpha_X,\alpha_W,\alpha_C)\in\mathcal K_{\mathrm{nuis}},\ (X,W)\in\mathcal G_{\mathrm{stat}}(F;\mathbb R^d),\ F=(f_{k\ell})_{k,\ell\in\{X,W\}},\ f_Xf_W-f_{XW}^2\ge\rho f_Xf_W,\ (Y(s_{i,N}))_{i=1}^N=(\beta X(s_{i,N})+W(s_{i,N}))_{i=1}^N\}\).
